retrieval units source: Stage B selected chunking configuration and Stage C1 indexed retrieval-unit embeddings
lexical rule: lowercase exact alphabetic content-word overlap; distinct shared tokens counted once
embedding rule: query encoding under the Stage C1 representation contract; exact cosine over every indexed unit
hybrid rule: divide each independent ranking score by its ranking maximum, add by stable retrieval identifier; empty ranking contributes nothing
reranking rule: cosine order over the first two lexical candidates only
